title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff & regional failover race under high load
author: Ava Chen
description: Context: We observed a recurring production incident where concurrent SLO enforcer backoff updates plus in-flight regional failover decisions caused a race that left some requests un-accounted for and triggered aggressive load-shedding in otherwise healthy regions. This manifested under sustained traffic spikes with short-lived regional blips (2026-02-26 incident SUP-7812). This PR contains a targeted hotfix that stabilizes the SLO enforcer's backoff state machine and makes regional failover orchestration idempotent and resilient to races. Changes: 1) Serialize critical sections in the enforcer when mutating backoff/quorum state and add a lightweight per-node coordination token to avoid dual-commit races; 2) Add a fast-path that short-circuits load-shedding decisions if a region has recently succeeded within the last 2s (reduces flip-flopping); 3) Make regional failover marker updates idempotent with optimistic retries and a bounded jitter to avoid stampeding updates; 4) Harden metrics and tracing so we can correlate backoff transitions with failover events (adds trace tags and a new counter slo_enforcer.backoff_transitions); 5) Add an integration test that reproduces the previous race with a synthetic load generator and asserts no dropped accounting or double-shedding. Testing and rollout: Unit and integration tests added. Ran full staging soak for 6 hours with synthetic spikes at 2x baseline and observed no regression across latency and error SLOs. CI: all checks passing; SRE validated with a canary in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 for 2 hours. Rollout plan: merge to main, backport to release-2026-02 and release-2026-01, roll out canary to 5% then 25% then 100% with SLO gates. Rollback: Revert is safe; changes are feature-flagged (slo_enforcer.hotfix_218922) and the flags are default-on but can be toggled via the console. Checklist: [x] Reproducing test, [x] Unit tests, [x] Integration test, [x] Staging soak, [x] SRE signoff, [x] Backport PRs prepared.

review_threads: Diego Morales (2026-02-28): Can you explain why we need both a per-node token and serialization? Looks redundant.

Ava Chen (2026-02-28): The token prevents cross-process dual-commit when serialization is scoped only to local in-memory state. We need both because serialization prevents intra-node races and the token avoids concurrent commits across replicas during partial network partitions.
Priya Patel (2026-02-28): Please add more assertions in the integration test to check metrics counters increment correctly when transitions happen.
Ava Chen (2026-02-28): Added counters assertions in latest commit c2d3f44.
Liam O'Connor (2026-03-01): Verified staging soak and canary results. Approving for merge.
Diego Morales (2026-03-01): Approve after minor comment addressed (expanded comment on token lifecycle).
release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover to prevent load-shedding thrash under high concurrent spikes. Adds safety for regional marker updates and improved tracing/metrics.
